_comment: Map 34's trees, read off the screenshot by eye (1-based X, Y). The art follows the original maps' rule: a tree is painted as a cone top in one tile and a round base with its trunk in the tile below, and forests stack the tops. So a tree stands on the tile BELOW each cone (Cones), and the tiles of row 1 that show a body at their top (TopBodies) hold a tree whose cone is off the map. A cone on the last row has its tree off the map and is only cleared. Colours: b = tree_blue, g = tree_dark_green (the crowns are exactly those models' palettes; the pale cones are the lit tops of the dark-green trees). Every tile a tree is painted on is cleared to the nearest plain grass.
